newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M says currencies cut 9 month profit.
newsitem.headline: H&M says currencies cut 9 month profit.

text.p: Swedish clothing retailer Hennes & Mauritz said on Thursday currency effects had reduced its nine-month 1995/96 profit by over 10 percent.
The company said in its result statement that currency effects had reduced sales by around 10 percent.
"And the effect was at least as great on the bottom line," H&M finance director Jan Jacobsen told Reuters.
The company earlier posted a 52 percent in pre-tax profits for the first nine months of the financial year to 1.02 billion crowns from 668 million in the same 1994/95 period.
